text:
I selected the unet_medium run (exp-20261031T232427Z-2342ff) for m-nz-cattle. Its validation mIoU is 0.8333, against 0.8231 for the unet_small baseline. This task's allowance was two experiments, so there was no room for further runs.

| Run | Model | Epochs | Val mIoU | Foreground IoU |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| exp-20261031T232317Z-05cee9 | unet_small | 12 | 0.8231 | 0.6554 |
| exp-20261031T232427Z-2342ff | unet_medium | 20 | 0.8333 | 0.6752 |

Both runs used 320px input, learning rate 0.003 and batch size 8. I changed model size and epoch count together, so I can't say how much each contributed to the gain. The gain is about one point of mIoU from a single seed, so treat it as small. Both curves were still creeping up at the last epoch.
